{{Quote|Sergeant Defain, Twenty-first Starfighter Division. Flew sorties at the Battle of Coruscant and Ilum, decorated for both.|Defain|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]''</ref>}}
Sergeant '''Defain''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] shuttle [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] in the [[Twenty-first Starfighter Division]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Our girl here's the right size, but she's built for stealth, not grit. Hold on tight.|Defain|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel" />}}
At the end of the [[Great Galactic War]] in [[3653 BBY]], Defain participated in the [[Sacking of Coruscant|battle]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where he flew sorties in the [[Twenty-first Starfighter Division]]. He also participated in the [[Battle of Ilum (Great Galactic War)|battle]] of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] in [[3640 BBY]].

Later around [[3638 BBY]], he was stationed over [[Makeb]] where he awaited an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] strike team to take down to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. However, during the landing, the shuttle crash-landed, leaving the Imperial strike team alone to handle the mission with the assistance of [[Katha Niar]]. Defain managed to survive, and the shuttle was repaired.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel" />
